description: Abstract class for validation in Zend Framework's validation component, defining core properties and methods for validation logic, message handling, and translation.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Abstract
classes.description: Abstract base class for validators in Zend Framework, providing common functionality for validation, message handling, and translation support.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieve array of validation failure messages.

methods.name: getMessageVariables
methods.description: Retrieve list of variable names used in message templates.

methods.name: getMessageTemplates
methods.description: Get the message templates used for validation failure messages.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Set a specific validation failure message template by key.

methods.name: setTranslator
methods.description: Assign a translation object to enable message translation.

methods.name: getTranslator
methods.description: Retrieve the current translation object, if any.

methods.name: hasTranslator
methods.description: Check if a specific translator has been set for this validator.

methods.name: setDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Set a default translator for all validators.

methods.name: getDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Retrieve the default translator, if set.

methods.name: hasDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Check if a default translator exists.

methods.name: setDisableTranslator
methods.description: Disable translation support for this validator.

methods.name: translatorIsDisabled
methods.description: Check whether translation is currently disabled.

methods.name: getMessageLength
methods.description: Get the maximum length of validation messages.

methods.name: setMessageLength
methods.description: Set the maximum length for validation messages.
